Correct: action, visible outcome and persistence are specified.

prompt: 把个人清单的创建、完成、筛选、共享拆成三个递进用户切片。
Split create/complete/filter/share into three incremental user slices.
sample: 可先创建并回看，再完成并按状态筛选，最后在明确权限下共享；各片列正常、空输入/无匹配和权限失败的验收。
First create/recover, then complete/filter, then share under defined permissions; specify relevant normal, empty and denied cases.
criteria: 每片端到端产生可观察价值。
Each slice produces an observable end-to-end outcome.
明确暂不包含的范围，避免把未做能力说成已完成。
State excluded scope rather than claiming unfinished capability.

title: 模块职责与接口
Module boundaries and interfaces
explain: 模块围绕职责与变化原因划界。解析器理解CSV或JSON格式，领域逻辑理解订单/价格规则，存储器理解文件或数据库；如果领域规则直接依赖某一CSV列位置，改格式会迫使业务规则跟着改。

Modules separate responsibilities and reasons for change. Parsers understand formats, domain logic understands business rules and storage understands persistence. Coupling rules to CSV column positions makes format changes disturb business behavior.
接口是调用者依赖的约定，应该说清输入、输出、错误和单位，而不是泄露全部内部结构。两个实现可共用同一组契约样例，让替换适配器时验证行为保持一致。接口也不能大到把所有职责混在一起。

An interface states inputs, outputs, errors and units without exposing every internal structure. Shared contract examples let alternative adapters be checked for equivalent behavior, while keeping responsibilities focused.

title: 模块职责与接口：完整示范
Module boundaries and interfaces: worked example
given: 合成运费规则：重量不超过2kg收费8元，超过则12元。数据可来自CSV或JSON，领域只接收规范重量数值。
Synthetic shipping: up to2kg costs8; above2 costs12. CSV and JSON input map to the same normalized weight.

title: 把格式转换放在边界
Normalize at the boundary
detail: CSV读取weight列、JSON读取weight属性；两者都转换并验证成kg数值，缺失/非法值作为输入错误，不在运费函数里查列号。
CSV/JSON adapters produce validated numeric kilograms; missing/invalid values are input errors, not column handling inside pricing.

title: 让领域函数只表达规则
Keep domain logic focused
detail: shipping(1.5)=8，shipping(3)=12；函数不应知道输入原本是CSV还是JSON，且负数不合法。
shipping(1.5)=8 and shipping(3)=12; the function need not know the source format, and negatives are invalid.

title: 用同一契约验证替换
Check alternatives with one contract
detail: 同一批1.5、2、3和非法输入经过两种适配器后，比较规范模型与最终运费；换格式不复制运费规则。
Run1.5,2,3 and invalid cases through both adapters, comparing normalized models and charges without duplicating the rule.

result: 格式变化被限制在适配器，规则有一个可信实现及可复用的契约例子。
Format changes stay within adapters while the rule has one implementation and reusable contract cases.

wrong: 新增JSON支持时复制整套CSV运费计算再改字段。
Copy the CSV pricing implementation to add JSON.
why: 两份规则会独立演化，一处改边界另一处漏改就产生不同价格。
Copies evolve separately and can disagree at a threshold.
correct: 解析到规范模型，领域规则只维护一次，分别测试适配器。
Normalize inputs and maintain the rule once, testing each adapter separately.

prompt: 把CSV列顺序调整后，哪部分理应首先承担变化？
CSV columns change order. Which part should normally adapt?

text: CSV解析适配器，领域契约保持不变
The CSV adapter, preserving the domain contract
feedback: 正确：只要规范输入含义不变，领域无须跟着列位置修改。
Correct: unchanged normalized meaning should preserve domain behavior.

text: 所有调用者和运费函数
All callers and the pricing function
feedback: 这说明格式细节泄漏到多个层。
That indicates widespread format coupling.

text: 把所有运费结果重新写死
feedback: 这没有解决职责边界，且不能处理新输入。
That neither fixes the boundary nor handles new inputs.

prompt: 为CSV和JSON订单导入画模块接口，包含金额单位与错误输出。
Design CSV/JSON order-import module contracts, including amount units and errors.
sample: 两解析器输出相同的订单模型与行级错误；金额单位明确为分，领域不读原始列号，存储接收已验证模型，重复规则统一。
Both parsers produce one order model and row errors; amounts use explicit cents, domain logic ignores raw columns and duplicate rules remain shared.
criteria: 格式、领域和存储职责可区分。
Format, domain and storage responsibilities are distinct.
替换实现有同输入/同输出的契约检查。
Alternative implementations share input/output contract checks.

title: 控制流与函数
Control flow and functions
explain: 条件决定走哪条路径，返回决定一条路径何时结束。边界上的等号、零值和错误分支经常比普通输入更容易出错；一个清楚的函数应让每种合法输入得到明确结果，非法输入得到约定拒绝。

Conditions choose paths and returns end them. Equality, zero and error cases often reveal more than ordinary inputs. A clear function gives every valid input a result and rejects invalid inputs explicitly.
守卫式提前返回能减少嵌套，但前提是不会跳过必要清理或产生部分状态。不要用if amount判断“金额合法”：在很多语言里0是假值，但它可以是合法金额；合法性来自契约，不是真值转换。

Guard returns reduce nesting only when cleanup and consistency remain correct. A truthiness test is not amount validation: zero may be false-like but valid. Contract rules, not coercion, define validity.

title: 控制流与函数：完整示范
Control flow and functions: worked example
given: 合成优惠：金额必须是非负整数分；满200减30，否则原价。输入199、200、201、0和−1。
Synthetic discount: amounts are nonnegative integer cents; totals at least200 receive30 off. Inputs199,200,201,0,−1.

title: 先处理非法输入
Reject invalid input first
detail: 检查整数且>=0，−1拒绝；不要静默改0，否则调用者不知道发生了输入错误。
Require an integer>=0 and reject−1 rather than silently substituting0.

title: 写出包含等号的阈值
Make the inclusive boundary explicit
detail: Use amount>=200:199→199,200→170,201→171. A strict > fails exactly at200.

title: 核对合法零与返回
Check zero and returns
detail: 0通过合法性检查但不达优惠门槛，返回0；每条路径只返回一个约定结果，不把错误也当数字成功返回。
Zero passes validation without the discount and returns0. Each path returns one contracted outcome; errors are not numeric success.

result: 非法、边界和普通路径有可追踪结果，函数可用具体输入逐项解释。
Invalid, boundary and ordinary paths have traceable, explainable outcomes.

wrong: 用if amount排除无效值，导致0也被拒绝。
Use if amount for validity and reject0.
why: 真值与业务合法性不同，0可能是有效输入。
Truthiness and domain validity differ; zero may be valid.
correct: 明确类型和范围校验，条件分支只表达真实业务门槛。
Validate type/range explicitly and let branches encode the real threshold.

prompt: 本例金额200应返回多少？
What should200 return under this contract?

feedback: 需求写满200，包含等号。
The requirement includes200.
正确：输入合法且位于包含的阈值。
Correct: valid input at the inclusive threshold.

text: 错误，因为阈值输入不合法
An error because threshold inputs are invalid
feedback: 阈值属于合法范围，不应额外排除。
The threshold is valid input.

prompt: 为满150减20且金额非负整数的规则写伪代码与149、150、151、0、负值结果。
Specify pseudocode and outputs for a20 discount at150, covering149,150,151,0 and a negative.
sample: 先拒绝非法类型和负值，再用>=150判断；结果149、130、131、0，负值拒绝。说明返回与错误类型，保留边界测试。
Reject invalid types/negatives, then apply >=150; outputs149,130,131,0 and rejection. Define result/error types and keep boundary tests.
criteria: 覆盖阈值前、等于、阈值后和合法零。
Cover below/equal/above threshold and valid zero.
错误不伪装成默认数值成功。
Errors do not masquerade as default numeric success.

title: 数据结构与复杂度
Data structures and complexity
explain: 数据结构选择要对应操作与语义。列表保留顺序，集合表达不重复成员，映射把键关联到值。只因为结果元素一样就替换结构，可能丢掉顺序或重复次数；先说明业务需要，再讨论性能。

Choose structures by operations and semantics. Lists preserve order, sets model distinct membership and maps associate keys with values. Equivalent members do not mean equivalent ordering or multiplicity; establish meaning before performance.
复杂度描述输入增长时工作量怎样增长，不直接给出毫秒。哈希集合通常能以平均常数时间查成员，但需要额外空间且依实现和输入；两两比较最坏会随n²增长。小数据“都很快”不能推断大数据等价。

Complexity describes growth, not milliseconds. Hash membership is typically average constant time with extra space and assumptions; pairwise comparison can grow quadratically. Similar small-input timings do not establish equivalent scaling.

title: 数据结构与复杂度：完整示范
Data structures and complexity: worked example
given: 合成输入b,a,b,c,a；要求去重但保留第一次出现的顺序。
Synthetic input b,a,b,c,a must be deduplicated while preserving first occurrence.

title: 拆开成员与顺序职责
Separate membership from order
detail: 使用seen集合判断是否出现过，output列表保存最终次序。单独使用Python set不能表达原输入首次顺序的契约。
Use seen for membership and an output list for order; a Python set alone does not express first-occurrence order.

title: 逐项跟踪状态
Trace each item
detail: b未见→加入两者；a未见→加入；第二个b已见→跳过；c加入；最后a跳过。每步都保留同一个成员判断规则。
Add b, add a, skip repeated b, add c, skip repeated a, using one consistent membership rule.

title: 核对语义和增长
Check semantics and growth
detail: output为b,a,c；每个输入做一次成员判断，平均线性过程，seen与output需额外空间。空输入输出空列表。
Output is b,a,c. One membership test per input gives an average linear process with extra space; empty input gives an empty list.

result: 集合负责“是否见过”，列表负责“以什么顺序交付”，两者共同满足契约。
The set answers whether seen; the list records delivery order, jointly satisfying the contract.

wrong: 只比较去重后数量，顺序不检查。
Check only the deduplicated count.
why: b,a,c和a,b,c数量相同，但可能不满足首次顺序需求。
The same count can conceal an incorrect ordering.
correct: 同时断言成员、无重复和首次顺序。
Assert membership, uniqueness and first-occurrence order.

prompt: 输入d,c,d,b，保首次顺序的结果是什么？
Deduplicate d,c,d,b by first occurrence. What is the result?

feedback: 集合不提供这种排序契约，而且需求是首次顺序。
That is not a set-order guarantee or the requested order.

text: d,c,d,b because deduplication concerns only size
feedback: 重复d仍在，连去重契约也未满足。
The duplicate remains.
正确：重复的第二个d被跳过，其余按首次出现保留。
Correct: skip the second d and retain first-occurrence order.

prompt: 比较1000个ID的两两重复扫描与seen集合方案，列顺序、时间增长和额外空间。
Compare pairwise and seen-set duplicate detection for1000 IDs: order, growth and space.
sample: 两两最坏二次，集合平均线性但需空间；要求保序时另留列表。用空、全重复与多样输入检查成员和顺序，不承诺固定毫秒。
Pairwise is quadratic in the worst case; hashing averages linear with space. Preserve order separately and test empty, repeated and varied inputs without fixed-millisecond promises.
criteria: 复杂度与具体耗时分开，说明假设。
Separate growth from measured time and state assumptions.
结构选择满足顺序和重复的业务语义。
Structures preserve required ordering and multiplicity.

title: 错误处理与边界输入
Errors and edge cases
explain: 错误至少分输入不合法、外部资源失败和程序缺陷。它们需要不同动作：用户能修正一行金额，但不能靠改金额修复磁盘不可写。错误分类是恢复策略的依据，不是给所有异常换同一句话。

Distinguish invalid input, external-resource failure and defects. Users can fix an amount, not repair disk permissions by changing it. Classification guides recovery rather than replacing every exception with one message.
异常应在能够理解和处理它的边界捕获，保留原因与上下文，同时不泄漏秘密。清理资源用可靠的finally或上下文管理；不能用宽泛捕获返回默认成功，否则调用者连失败是否发生都不知道。
Catch exceptions where they can be understood and handled, preserving useful context without secrets. Use reliable cleanup, and avoid broad catches returning false success.

title: 错误处理与边界输入：完整示范
Errors and edge cases: worked example
given: 合成CSV导入金额列：第4行是bad；也可能文件不存在。要求坏行可记录，文件不存在则停止整次导入。
Synthetic CSV import has bad in amount row4; the file may also be absent. Row parsing may be recorded, while missing input stops the import.

title: 先判断资源可否取得
Acquire the resource
detail: 打开文件若失败，返回文件不可读的约定错误，不进入逐行金额解析；不能把FileNotFoundError解释成第1行金额错误。
If opening fails, return the contracted resource error without row parsing; do not mislabel missing input as an invalid amount.

title: 在行边界处理可恢复错误
Handle row-level recovery
detail: 第4行转换整数产生ValueError，记录行4、字段amount和原值bad；按本例策略保留坏行问题，继续其他合法行。
For row4, record the parse error with field/raw value; continue valid rows only under this stated partial-import policy.

title: 给出真实结果并清理
Report and clean up
detail: 报告已接收行与拒绝行，不将坏行当0；退出时关闭文件。若写结果文件失败，另报存储失败，不宣称导入已完成。
Report accepted/rejected rows without replacing bad with0, close resources and report output-write failure separately.

result: 调用者知道是修输入、找文件还是处理存储故障，且不会收到假成功。
The caller knows whether to repair input, locate a file or handle storage failure, without false success.

wrong: except Exception后返回0，避免程序报错。
Catch Exception and return0 to avoid errors.
why: 0可能是合法金额，吞掉错误会把未知/失败变成看似真实的数据。
Zero may be legitimate; swallowing failures fabricates valid-looking data.
correct: 捕获具体可处理异常，保留行号和原因；无法恢复时明确失败。
Handle specific recoverable exceptions with context and fail explicitly otherwise.

prompt: 金额bad和文件不存在应使用相同的“金额设0继续”处理吗？
Should bad amount and missing file both become0 and continue?

text: 不应，按错误类型与恢复契约分开
No; separate by type and recovery contract
feedback: 正确：先判断能恢复什么，再决定继续或停止。
Correct: recovery capability determines continuation.

text: 应当，所有异常统一最简单
feedback: 它混淆了可恢复行错误和缺失资源，还制造数据。
It conflates row recovery with unavailable input and invents data.

text: 都向用户展示完整系统堆栈
Show complete internal stacks for both
feedback: 堆栈可能泄露内部细节，也不等于可操作的反馈。
Stacks can reveal internals without actionable guidance.

prompt: 设计导入工具对坏金额、缺文件、重复ID和写盘失败的错误与清理策略。
Specify import behavior for malformed amounts, missing files, duplicate IDs and failed output writes.
sample: 分别列继续/停止条件，记录必要行号和原值；拒绝不伪造0，重复不擅自覆盖，资源总能释放，失败不会被报告成功。
Define continue/stop conditions, retain necessary row/raw context, invent no zeros, overwrite no duplicates silently and clean resources without false success.
criteria: 错误与恢复动作对应，不用一个默认值吞掉所有问题。
Recovery follows error meaning, not one default.
清理、秘密最小化与实际结果都有说明。
Address cleanup, minimized disclosure and truthful outcomes.

title: 单元测试与边界
Unit tests and boundaries
explain: 单元测试针对小边界上的明确行为。安排输入、调用动作、断言预期是三个不同步骤；预期值来自需求和独立推导，而不是在测试里复制实现，否则同一个错误可能在两边同时出现。

A unit test checks explicit behavior at a small boundary. Setup, action and assertion are distinct; derive expectations independently from the requirement rather than copying the implementation and its possible bug.
普通、空、边界和错误都是契约的一部分。只断言“不抛异常”无法区分正确数值与错误结果；测试也应彼此独立，控制时间、随机和外部状态，让失败能稳定说明哪条规则被破坏。

Normal, empty, boundary and error cases are contractual. No-exception assertions miss wrong values. Independent tests with controlled time/random/external state make failures diagnostic and repeatable.

title: 单元测试与边界：完整示范
Unit tests and boundaries: worked example
given: 合成函数total返回金额和：total([4,9])=13，total([])=0。错误实现却返回列表长度。
Synthetic total sums amounts: [4,9]→13 and []→0. A faulty implementation returns list length.

title: 给出独立预期
Derive expectations independently
detail: 按加法4+9算出13，不在测试里再次调用被测算法来求“预期”。空列表约定为加法单位0。
Derive13 from4+9, not by calling the implementation for its expected value. The empty contract uses additive identity0.

title: 写具体值断言
Assert concrete values
detail: 一条断言total([4,9])==13，另一条total([])==0。只写函数可调用，两种实现都会通过。
Assert the two values separately. Both implementations can pass a merely callable/no-exception check.

title: 用故意破坏验证测试价值
Check defect sensitivity
detail: 长度实现返回2，会被第一条抓住；它在空输入返回0却能通过第二条，说明需要有区分力的组合。
The length implementation returns2 and fails the normal case, while still passing empty0; a discriminating combination is needed.

result: 测试既覆盖需求，也确实能发现代表性错误，不以测试数量替代证据。
Tests cover the contract and detect a representative defect rather than relying on count.

wrong: 预期值完全重复被测函数中的同一段条件代码。
Copy the same condition code to calculate expected values.
why: 实现和测试可能以同一种方式犯错，测试只证明两份代码一致。
Both can share the same defect, establishing agreement rather than correctness.
correct: 从需求手算边界预期，加入能区分错误实现的反例。
Derive boundary expectations from the contract and include discriminating cases.

prompt: 函数把[2,8]错误算成2，哪种断言能发现？
A faulty sum returns2 for[2,8]. Which assertion catches it?

feedback: 错误数值同样能正常返回。
Wrong values can return normally.
正确：这是独立算出的具体期望。
Correct:10 is a concrete independently derived expectation.
2也是数字，不足以判断业务结果。
Two is also numeric.

prompt: 给满250减25的非负整数金额规则写249、250、251和负值的测试。
Test a25 discount at250 for249,250,251 and a negative.
sample: 预期249、225、226，负值按契约拒绝；再故意把>=改>，确认250用例失败，说明错误被捕获。
Expect249,225,226 and rejection; deliberately change>= to> and confirm the250 case detects it.
criteria: 预期来源独立，断言具体结果/错误。
Expectations are independent and concrete.
至少一个代表缺陷会使测试失败，且测试彼此隔离。
A representative defect fails and tests remain independent.

title: 复现与定位
Reproduction and debugging
explain: 调试是用证据区分候选原因。最小复现保留能稳定触发问题的最少条件；一次同时改缓存、排序和数据库，虽然现象可能消失，却无法知道哪项起作用，也难以防止回归。

Debugging distinguishes hypotheses with evidence. A minimal reproduction preserves the smallest reliable trigger. Changing cache, sorting and database together may remove a symptom without explaining or preventing it.
好的假设必须能被观察推翻。先固定版本、输入、时间顺序，再设计只改变有意义因素的实验。日志和调试器也可能改变竞态时序，因此难复现时应保留出现条件与频率，不编造确定根因。

A useful hypothesis can be falsified. Fix version/input/order, then vary a meaningful factor. Instrumentation can affect races, so retain conditions/frequency instead of inventing certainty when reproduction is hard.

title: 复现与定位：完整示范
Reproduction and debugging: worked example
given: 合成函数第一次读取名称“甲”，修改为“乙”后第二次仍返回“甲”；怀疑缓存失效遗漏。
Synthetic reads return A, then still A after updating to B; cache invalidation is suspected.

title: 固定最小复现
Fix the reproduction
detail: 在同一版本执行读取→更新→再读三步，记录每步值。去掉不相关界面，确认错误确实在这个顺序出现。
Reproduce read→update→read on one version, recording values without unrelated UI.

title: 做能区分假设的实验
Design a distinguishing experiment
detail: 仅对这个测试关闭缓存；若二次读变乙，支持缓存相关方向，但仍需查缓存键、更新时失效及写入时点。
Disable cache only for this test. If B appears, investigate keys, invalidation and write timing rather than declaring all caching broken.

title: 修复并保留回归
Repair and retain regression
detail: 修正该更新路径的失效后，用原三步验证乙；另查未更新重复读和不同对象，避免把所有缓存永久关闭当结案。
Repair that path and verify B, then check unchanged reads and other objects; do not substitute blanket cache removal for a diagnosis.

result: 结论来自可重放实验和相邻对照，修复有防回归证据。
The conclusion follows replayable experiments and controls, with regression evidence.

wrong: 现象消失后立刻写“确定是数据库问题”，不保存复现。
Call it a database root cause as soon as the symptom disappears.
why: 症状消失和根因成立不是同一件事，没有区分实验也不能排除其他因素。
Symptom recovery does not establish cause or exclude alternatives.
correct: 记录候选、实验、预期和观察，再写与证据相符的结论。
Record hypotheses, experiments, expectations and observations before concluding.

prompt: 关缓存后问题消失，可以直接认定应该永久禁用全部缓存吗？
The issue disappears without caching. Must all caching be disabled permanently?

text: 可以，所有缓存都是错的
feedback: 这把一个诊断实验扩大成无依据的全局设计结论。
That overgeneralizes a diagnostic experiment.

text: 不可以，所以实验毫无价值
No, so the experiment has no value
feedback: 它有区分候选的价值，只需保留结论边界。
It remains valuable evidence within its scope.

text: 不可以，还需定位缓存键和失效路径
feedback: 正确：实验缩小了方向，尚未决定最合适的修复。
Correct: it narrows the cause without establishing the best repair.

prompt: 一个函数只在空列表时报错，制作最小复现、两条假设与一个区分实验。
A function fails only on empty input. Build a reproduction, two hypotheses and one distinguishing experiment.
sample: 固定版本，用[]与单元素对照；定位是否读取首项或除以长度，再只改对应守卫并复查空/非空和原输出。
Fix the version, compare empty/singleton, distinguish first-item access from divide-by-length, change the relevant guard and retain both regressions.
criteria: 实验能区分原因，而非只重复发生问题。
The experiment distinguishes causes beyond reproducing symptoms.
修复有原复现和相邻正常场景的对照。
Verify both the original trigger and adjacent normal behavior.

title: 重构与兼容性
Refactoring and compatibility
explain: 重构改变内部组织而保持约定外部行为。把一个大函数拆成计算和格式化可以改善职责，但若顺便改返回类型、舍入或错误规则，就包含了行为变更，应该单独说明而不是藏在“清理代码”里。

Refactoring changes internal organization while preserving contracted external behavior. Splitting calculation from formatting may improve responsibilities, but return-type, rounding or error changes are behavioral changes that must be declared.
先锁定行为再移动结构。普通、边界和错误样例帮助判断新实现是否兼容；没有证据时先补最关键的行为记录。重复代码看起来相似也可能承担不同需求，不能为了消除重复而抹去有意差异。

Characterize behavior before restructuring. Normal, boundary and error cases reveal compatibility. Similar-looking duplicate code can encode intentional differences, so extracting it must not erase requirements.

title: 重构与兼容性：完整示范
Refactoring and compatibility: worked example
given: 合成折扣函数输入整数分，满1000减100，返回数字。现在希望拆成计算与展示两部分。
A synthetic discount takes integer cents, deducts100 at1000 and returns a number. Split calculation from display.

title: 记录外部契约
Record the external contract
detail: 给999、1000、1001保留预期999、900、901；负值拒绝。调用者依赖的是数值，不只是屏幕上的字符。
Characterize999→999,1000→900,1001→901 and negative rejection; callers depend on numbers, not just displayed characters.

title: 小步分离职责
Separate responsibilities in small steps
detail: 提取calculate只返回整数金额，format只负责按约定显示。旧对外函数仍给调用者原类型，必要时把展示放在原边界之外。
Extract numeric calculation and formatting separately while preserving the old public return type.

title: 比较行为而非只看代码
Compare behavior, not appearance
detail: 分别核对类型、数值、错误与调用者。如果结果900变成字符串"900"，虽然UI相似，类型契约已经改变，不能算纯重构。
Compare types, values, errors and callers. String "900" is not the same contract as number900 despite similar display.

result: 内部职责更清楚而外部行为有证据保持；确需改契约时另做迁移。
Internal responsibilities improve with evidenced behavior preservation; intentional contract changes need migration.

wrong: 为了统一写法，直接把两个相似函数的>=与>全部改成一样。
Unify >= and > in similar functions to remove duplication.
why: 阈值差别可能是不同需求；未确认就合并会造成边界行为变化。
The difference may be intentional; unverified unification changes boundary behavior.
correct: 先判断差异是否有意，用契约测试保护后再提取或明确修缺陷。
Determine intent, characterize behavior, then extract or explicitly fix a defect.

prompt: 返回数字30改成字符串"30"，显示相同，属于已证明兼容的重构吗？
Changing number30 to string "30" looks the same. Is that proven compatible refactoring?

text: 不是，返回类型变化需明确处理
No; the type change needs explicit handling
feedback: 正确：应保留原类型或把它作为行为变更评估迁移。
Correct: preserve it or assess migration as a behavior change.
调用者可能要计算或严格比较，类型也是契约。
Callers may calculate or compare strictly; type is contractual.
行数不能证明外部行为不变。
Line count is not behavioral evidence.

prompt: 两处折扣逻辑只有一个边界符号不同，制定提取前的核对与迁移计划。
Plan characterization and extraction for two discount functions differing at one boundary.
sample: 列相同与不同场景，向需求确认边界意图；测试保护各自契约后提取共同部分，若统一行为则单列破坏性影响和迁移。
Document shared/different cases, confirm threshold intent, protect contracts and extract only common parts; declare migration if unifying behavior.
criteria: 明确区分结构调整、修缺陷和契约改变。
Separate restructuring, defect fixes and contract changes.
结果包含类型、错误、边界及调用者验证。
Verify types, errors, boundaries and callers.

title: Git 分支与合并
Git branches and merges
explain: Git分支是指向提交的可移动引用。合并通常比较共同祖先与双方改动，目的是整合意图；文本冲突只是Git无法自动决定的编辑位置，没有文本冲突也不保证业务兼容。

A Git branch is a movable commit reference. A merge compares changes relative to a common ancestor to combine intent. Text conflicts mark unresolved edits; a conflict-free merge still does not establish semantic compatibility.
解决冲突需要知道双方为何改。ours/theirs是特定操作上下文中的两侧，不是“正确/错误”标签。先保留现有未提交工作，再在隔离演练仓库理解冲突；不要在用户主工程用重置或整份覆盖来练习。

Conflict resolution requires both intentions. ours/theirs are contextual sides, not correctness labels. Preserve uncommitted work and rehearse in a separate repository rather than resetting or overwriting shared work.

title: Git 分支与合并：完整示范
Git branches and merges: worked example
given: 合成配置的共同祖先是timeout=10,retries=1；A改timeout=20，B改retries=3，合并时同一行冲突。
A synthetic base has timeout10/retries1. BranchA changes timeout20; B changes retries3, conflicting on one line.

title: 读共同祖先和两边意图
Inspect base and intentions
detail: 共同祖先说明旧值；A调整等待预算，B调整重试次数。只看带标记的最终文件还不足以知道两项改动的目的。
The base shows old values; A changes waiting budget and B retries. Read both intentions, not just the conflict markers.

title: 合成符合两项意图的内容
Combine the intended content
detail: 在确认两者可同时成立后写timeout=20,retries=3，删除冲突标记。不是整份选择A或B，而是逐项保留规则。
After checking compatibility, resolve to timeout20/retries3 and remove markers, preserving both rules rather than choosing a whole side.

title: 验证并审查完整差异
Validate and review the full diff
detail: 检查配置可解析、时间总预算仍允许这组值，再看status/diff并运行相关测试。暂存冲突解决不等于业务验收已经通过。
Check parsing and total timing budget, inspect status/diff and run relevant tests. Staging a resolution is not itself business acceptance.

result: 合并结果保留双方意图且有兼容检查；无标记只是一项必要条件。
The result preserves both intentions with compatibility evidence; no markers is only one necessary condition.

wrong: 删除冲突标记并保留任意一边，就算正确完成。
Remove markers and keep either side arbitrarily.
why: 语法可能成立，但另一边有效改动会悄悄消失。
Syntax may pass while a valid change is lost.
correct: 逐项解释共同祖先与两边改动，检查整合后的行为。
Explain base and both changes, then validate the combined behavior.

prompt: 本例若直接整份采用A，遗漏了什么？
What is lost if the whole A version is accepted?

feedback: 采用A会保留它，不是遗漏项。
A’s version retains that change.
正确：解决文本冲突也必须防止有效意图被覆盖。
Correct: textual resolution must preserve valid intent.

text: 共同祖先本身一定丢失
The base necessarily disappears from history
feedback: 选择文件内容与提交历史是否保留不是同一概念。
Resolved content and preservation of commit history differ.

prompt: 只在独立临时仓库演练两个分支改同一配置，记录基线、双方意图和验证。
Rehearse conflicting configuration changes only in a separate temporary repository.
sample: 记录提交关系，保留原配置与两侧差异，逐项整合后检查解析/业务预算/测试；主工作区不重置，不把删除标记等同正确合并。
Record commits/base/diffs, combine intentionally and check parsing/budget/tests. Do not reset shared work or equate marker removal with correctness.
criteria: 合并解释能覆盖双方变更与共同祖先。
Explain both changes relative to the base.
演练隔离，验证最终差异而非仅冲突标记。
Rehearse in isolation and verify the final diff.

title: 代码审查与反馈
Code review
explain: 代码审查把注意力放在具体变化的风险：输入条件、控制流、权限、数据和错误处理。有效意见指出位置、触发条件、影响和可验证的修正方向，让作者知道下一步怎样证明问题已解决。

Code review evaluates change-specific risks in inputs, control flow, permissions, data and errors. Useful feedback locates the issue, trigger, impact and a verifiable correction so authors can demonstrate resolution.
必须修复与可选建议要分开。业务边界变错属于正确性问题，变量名偏好未必应阻塞。审查结论也有范围：看过代码、测试通过、实际运行是不同证据，不能用批准动作代替未做的验证。

Distinguish blockers from suggestions. Incorrect boundaries affect correctness; naming preferences may not block. Reading code, passing tests and executing a path are different evidence, not interchangeable with approval.

title: 代码审查与反馈：完整示范
Code review: worked example
given: 合成优惠规则“金额满500减50”，改动把>=500写成>500，没有补测500。
Synthetic contract: deduct50 at totals at least500. A change uses >500 instead of >=500, without a500 test.

title: 从需求走到具体触发
Connect requirement to trigger
detail: 499不受影响，501仍优惠，只有500会从450变成500；先写清这条可复现行为，而不是泛泛说逻辑不好。
499 is unchanged and501 still qualifies, but500 changes from450 to500. State that precise trigger instead of criticizing vaguely.

title: 写有依据的阻塞意见
Write an evidenced blocker
detail: 指出条件行和满500的约定，要求恢复包含边界或明确需求已变；给输入500、预期450作为可验证例子。
Reference the condition and inclusive requirement, asking for restoration or an explicit requirement change, with500→450 as evidence.

title: 在修订后复查
Recheck the revision
detail: 核对修改及499/500/501测试，并检查其他调用路径是否复用这条规则。已解决意见按最终差异关闭，不只看作者回复“已改”。
Inspect the revision and499/500/501 tests plus shared callers; resolve based on the final diff, not only a claim that it is fixed.

result: 审查意见能触发实际修正与验证，风格建议不掩盖正确性风险。
Review leads to a concrete repair and verification without burying correctness under style.

wrong: 只评论“代码太差，需要重写”。
Comment only that the code is bad and must be rewritten.
why: 没有位置、条件与影响，作者无法验证到底要修什么，也不利于形成可复查证据。
Without location, trigger and impact, the author cannot verify the requested repair.
correct: 给出具体反例、规则依据与期望，区分阻塞和建议。
Provide a counterexample, rule and expectation, separating blockers from suggestions.

prompt: 下面哪条意见最可行动？
Which review comment is most actionable?

text: I dislike this style; use another
feedback: 没有可验证的需求或问题。
There is no verifiable problem or requirement.

text: 测试数量不够，多写十条
There are too few tests; add ten
feedback: 数量不能说明缺少哪项行为证据。
A count does not identify missing behavioral evidence.

text: 此处>漏掉满500场景，输入500应得450，请补边界测试
The > excludes500; expected500→450. Add a boundary test
feedback: 正确：位置、触发、期望和验证动作都清楚。
Correct: location, trigger, expectation and verification are explicit.

prompt: 审查把缺失金额默认为0并入库的改动，写一条阻塞和一条可选建议。
Review a change defaulting missing amounts to0, with one blocker and one suggestion.
sample: 阻塞指出缺失输入被伪装成真实零收入，要求按契约拒绝或保留未知并补用例；可选建议可改善错误命名，但不能替代数据修复。
Block the fabricated zero with contract-based rejection/unknown handling and a regression case; a naming suggestion is optional and does not replace the data fix.
criteria: 重要意见包含具体输入、影响与规则依据。
Important feedback includes input, impact and rule.
区分必要修复、风格建议与实际验证范围。
Separate required fixes, preferences and verified scope.

title: 发布版本与交接
Versioned releases and handoff
explain: 版本号是契约变化的说明，构建身份是实际内容的标识。相同页脚版本可能对应不同源码或依赖，只有提交、依赖锁、构建配置和产物摘要能把“测试了什么”与“运行了什么”连起来。

A version describes contract change; build identity identifies actual content. Identical displayed versions can hide different source/dependencies. Commits, locks, configuration and artifact digests connect tested and running content.
语义版本要求先定义公开API。稳定版本的破坏性API改变应按相应主版本规则处理，不能因为叫“修复”就自动发patch。发布还包括迁移和恢复条件：旧代码是否能读取新数据，比回退按钮是否存在更重要。

Semantic versioning starts with a declared public API. Incompatible changes in a stable API need the appropriate major version, even when called fixes. Migration/recovery also require old code to understand new data.

title: 发布版本与交接：完整示范
Versioned releases and handoff: worked example
given: 合成产品稳定公开API为2.4.1，候选移除旧字段name，改用displayName；页面仍显示2.4.1。
A synthetic stable public API is2.4.1. A candidate removes name for displayName, while its page still displays2.4.1.

title: 先判断对调用者的影响
Assess consumer impact
detail: 依赖name的调用者会失败，属于公开契约不兼容，不因新名字更合理而变成兼容修复。
Consumers relying on name break; a better field name does not make the removal compatible.

title: 设计版本与迁移
Plan version and migration
detail: 按本例SemVer政策安排主版本变化，或先兼容提供新旧字段并声明弃用周期；记录客户如何迁移及何时移除。
Under this SemVer policy plan a major change, or first support both fields with a stated deprecation/migration period.

title: 绑定实际产物与恢复
Bind artifacts and recovery
detail: 构建后记录摘要，部署验收核对实际资源而不是页脚。回退前核对数据库和外部调用是否仍兼容旧字段。
Record build digests and verify actual served artifacts rather than the footer; check data and external-protocol compatibility before rollback.

result: 发布记录说明真实内容、兼容影响、迁移和回退前提，版本号不再是装饰。
The release record identifies content, compatibility, migration and recovery conditions rather than treating a version as decoration.

wrong: 把删字段称为修复，就直接升级到2.4.2。
Call the field removal a fix and publish2.4.2.
why: 是否破坏调用者由公开契约决定，不由变更名称决定。
Compatibility follows the public contract, not the change label.
correct: 分析消费者影响，采用声明的版本政策并给迁移路径。
Assess consumer impact, apply the version policy and provide migration.

prompt: 页脚版本相同，但资源摘要不同，能直接复用另一构建的验收结论吗？
The footer version matches but artifact digests differ. Can prior build acceptance be reused automatically?

text: 不能，先识别实际构建并判断需重验范围
No; identify the build and determine revalidation scope
feedback: 正确：证据要绑定实际内容。
Correct: evidence belongs to identified content.

text: 能，版本文字是唯一依据
feedback: 不同产物可能有不同代码，旧证据不能自动覆盖。
Different artifacts can contain different code.
文件名不能证明字节或行为一致。
Filenames do not establish identical bytes or behavior.

prompt: 给稳定API删除字段的发布写版本、迁移、产物身份、验收与恢复记录。
Write version, migration, artifact, acceptance and recovery notes for removing a stable API field.
sample: 列消费者影响、过渡方案和移除时间，记录提交/依赖锁/产物摘要及实际检查；明确旧代码对新数据和调用者兼容性，未测范围如实列出。
Record consumers, transition/removal timing, commit/lock/digests and actual checks, including old-code compatibility with new data and callers and any untested scope.
criteria: 版本决策基于公开契约而非主观“修复”命名。
Version decisions follow the public contract.
证据、迁移和恢复都能对应实际构建。
Evidence, migration and recovery identify the actual build.
